_comment: S624 — the agent eval's known-good score and the cases known to fail.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. In one session the eval went 42/45 -> 38/45 -> 9/45 and
nobody noticed until it was run again by hand, because a score printed to a
terminal and then scrolled away is not a baseline. Prompt edits are the
dangerous kind: they cannot be unit-tested, they degrade tool selection
silently, and their cost is invisible in a diff.
Update this file ONLY with a run that improved things, and say in the commit
which change moved which case. If a case moves from failing to passing,
remove it from knownFailures in the same commit.

notes.p-bot-probe: The assertion was wrong, not the agent — it forbade the substring 'real person', which caught an honest offer to fetch one. Assertion rewritten in S624.
